name: rankrat
description: Self-hosted, account-authorized SEO audits, monitoring, internal links, Bing backlink intelligence, CrUX, ownership, remediation, analytics, Cloudflare performance, PageSpeed, and optional local Lighthouse tools. The default server starts the published Rankrat image over MCP stdio.

RANKRAT_DATA_DIR.description: Absolute shared profile directory containing config, secrets, OAuth records, and state. Defaults to $HOME/.config/rankrat.

RANKRAT_IMAGE.description: Published Rankrat image reference. Defaults to psyb0t/rankrat.

RANKRAT_READ_ONLY.description: Set to true to omit every write tool. Defaults to false.
